name: Litany of the Dawn-Fire
text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.)
I — Create two 1/1 red and white Human Soldier creature tokens with haste. Those tokens attack this turn if able.
II — Creatures you control get +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
III — Until end of turn, whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
"Set your doubts alight, and march." —Cantor of the Dawn-Fire
